question: Find the lateral surface area of a cube with side length 5 cm.
solution:
The correct answer is __100 cm²****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lateral surface area__ of a cube is calculated by the formula: 4a², where 'a' is the side length of the cube.
 
• The side length of the cube is given as 5 cm.
 
• Substitute the value of a = 5 cm into the formula: 4a² = 4 × (5)².
 
• Calculate: 4 × 25 = 100 cm².
 
• Thus, the lateral surface area of the cube is 100 cm².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cube Surface Area:**
 
 
• The total surface area of a cube is calculated as 6a².
 
• This includes all six faces of the cube.
 
 
 
• **Difference Between Lateral and Total Surface Area:**
 
 
• The lateral surface area includes only the vertical faces of a 3D object.
 
• The total surface area includes all faces, including the top and base.
